_note: Word list for the twin-card Pictionary sheets (Fun Informatics 3). scripts/fun-informatics-03/twin_cards.py prints it. Each hint lists what the left thing has and the right one does not, then the other way round. The round-1 words are the twin that is easier to mistake for the other one, so round one goes wrong on its own and round two can draw the same things again.
